title: Crypto Price Analysis 4-17: BITCOIN: BTC, ETHEREUM: ETH, SOLANA: SOL, LITECOIN: LTC, APTOS: APT, UNISWAP: UNI, COSMOS: ATOM
text: The crypto market registered a substantial drop on Wednesday before recovering towards the end of the day after Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell flagged concerns about inflation and slowing growth due to tariffs.
